reviews.title: Worth every penny.
reviews.comment: After months of using it, I’m very happy with this curved monitor so far. The screen size and subtle curve make a noticeable difference, especially for multitasking, watching videos, and general computer work. The curve feels natural and helps keep everything in view without needing to constantly move my head. The design is clean and modern with slim bezels, and it looks great on my desk. Setup was quick and easy right out of the box. The display quality is solid—colors look good, text is clear, and brightness is more than enough for daily use. It performs well for office work, browsing, and streaming, and even casual gaming feels more immersive compared to a flat screen. Build quality is decent for the price. While it’s not a high-end premium monitor, it feels sturdy and well-made. Overall, this is an excellent value if you’re looking for an affordable curved monitor that delivers good performance and comfort.
reviews.author: Emily Jin

reviews.title: Very good monitor for low price
reviews.comment: The monitor was fairly easy to set up; it comes with the screws (4 mini screws to attach the base handle to the monitor and 1 medium screw to attach the legs to the base handle of monitor). Overall, you should have 2 mini screws and 1 medium screw left over. The picture quality is very good for the price and it runs my online game very well (no lagging) but I do prefer to play on my other monitor but simply modifying the graphic settings can make it better. Cons: the on/off button is on the back of the monitor and looks like a joy stick so ensure to read the directions to know how to toggle the settings, etc. Also, although it is a 24-inch monitor and curved, it does not adjust like my other monitors so it sits very low compared to the other ones. If your space permits it, you may need a monitor rise so it isn't so low to your other monitor if you are using two monitors. Pros: Good quality for the price. It comes with an HDMI cord so as long as your computer can take HDMI, you don't need to buy one. It is fairly easy to set up (should take no longer than 15 - 20 minutes from opening to turning it on.
reviews.author: Sherri Fauci

reviews.title: AMAZING Gaming Monitor!!
reviews.comment: I bought this monitor for my son and he absolutely loves it! It's got phenomenal clarity, the color is amazing, the curvature is amazing, it works really well, it's high quality and it was very easy to install. We love it! The size is perfect and it's extremely sturdy. The mountability was great & easy to do, manage and maneuver. It's very sturdy and secure. We love it!
reviews.author: Heidi M.

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.comment: I bought this monitor, and it exceeded my expectations. The quality is very good for the price. I liked it because it delivers exactly what it promises. I’ve been using it for several days, and so far, everything has gone wonderfully—without any issues. Plus, it arrived quickly and was well-packaged.
reviews.author: Yunier Madrigal

reviews.title: Excellent replacement for my old Dell monitor
reviews.comment: This 24” 1800R curved monitor has absolutely no business being this good at this price. The 180Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time are legitimately smooth—none of the ghosting, smearing, or “maybe my eyes are tired” excuses you get with cheap panels. Flip on FreeSync and it’s just clean, fluid motion. Fast games feel great, and the curve actually adds to the experience instead of being a gimmick. Colors? Surprisingly solid. Viewing angles? No drama. The build feels sturdier than it has any right to be. They even toss in an HDMI cable, which is more generosity than most “premium” brands manage. VESA mount support is there if you want to stick it on an arm and pretend you’re running a command center. (I am.) I’ve been using it daily for over a week, and honestly—it’s one of the best budget gaming monitors I’ve picked up. If your wallet is not cooperating but you still want a real high-refresh curved display, this is the one.
reviews.author: Jennifer Guerrero
